entities.summary: Peter Schilling (b. 1956-01-28, Stuttgart) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Stuttgart and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
